# Set-Up

```{r}
library(sf)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Load Data

```{r}
arts = st_read(
  "../ARTS/ARTS_main_dataset/v.6.0.0/ARTS_main_dataset_v.6.0.0.geojson"
)
tk_landscapes = st_read(
  "../rts_rep_analysis/input_data/OlefeldtThermokarstMap/data/Circumpolar_Thermokarst_Landscapes_epsg3413.shp"
)
```

# Area Distribution

```{r}
arts_filter = arts |>
  separate(
    BaseMapDate,
    into = c("BaseMapDateStart", "BaseMapDateEnd"),
    sep = ",",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(BaseMapDateStart, BaseMapDateEnd),
      ~ as.Date(.x)
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    TrainClass == "Positive" &
      LabelType == "Polygon" &
      BaseMapDateEnd == max(BaseMapDateEnd),
    .by = c(UID)
  )

arts_filter = arts_filter |>
  mutate(
    Area = as.numeric(st_area(arts_filter))
  ) |>
  set_variable_labels(Area = expression("Area (m^2)"))
```

```{r}
area_hist = ggplot(
  arts_filter,
  aes(x = Area)
) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10000, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = expression("Area (m"^2 ~ ")")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Count",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  )

# ggsave(
#   "./figures/rts_area.jpg",
#   area_hist,
#   height = 3,

# )

area_bin_data = ggplot_build(area_hist)$data[[1]]
area_bin_data = area_bin_data |>
  select(area_min = xmin, area_max = xmax, count)
```
